Disaggregation reveals disproportionate impacts: Pacific Northwest regions experienced 340% increases in displacement rates versus 89% in the Southwest. Current emergency management frameworks assume stationary disaster probabilities. The evidence conclusively demonstrates an ongoing paradigm shift in wildfire severity and displacement scale. The displacement crisis is not episodic but trending, requiring data-driven resource allocation that acknowledges the statistical reality of escalating compound disasters.
